capabilities: log mood, activities, and an optional note into daily notes
save entries as nested tags in English or Japanese sections
render a read-only dashboard with 30/90-day and all-time mood statistics
follow Daily notes settings or use manual folder, date-format, and template settings
extras: README claims no network requests or telemetry; entries are plain Markdown and existing logs are never rewritten or migrated. The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record structured mood entries with activities and later review mood statistics across the vault.
summary: Mood tracker that logs a required five-level mood, optional activities, and a note into the daily note, plus a read-only mood dashboard.
